locations.label: Dragon Command power
locations.description: Reach Dragon Command, turn on power and interact with SOPHIA. Enemies can now drop colored Code Cylinders. Insert each cylinder in its matching terminal: blue at Dragon Command, yellow at Supply Depot, red at Tank Factory. Follow the green beam to its Groph Module and protect it with nearby kills until it opens. Collect the Network Circuit and repeat for all three colors. If a module is destroyed, obtain another cylinder and retry. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: SOPHIA
locations.description: Reach Dragon Command, turn on power and interact with SOPHIA. Enemies can now drop colored Code Cylinders. Insert each cylinder in its matching terminal: blue at Dragon Command, yellow at Supply Depot, red at Tank Factory. Follow the green beam to its Groph Module and protect it with nearby kills until it opens. Collect the Network Circuit and repeat for all three colors. If a module is destroyed, obtain another cylinder and retry. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Dragon Network Controller
locations.description: Install the three circuits in the Dragon Network Controller in Operations Bunker. Pay 2,000 points at an active dragon platform to ride to the Hatchery, where Pack-a-Punch is available. The stations are Dragon Command, Supply Depot and Tank Factory. Leave through the Hatchery’s lower sewer chute when finished. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Hatchery Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: Install the three circuits in the Dragon Network Controller in Operations Bunker. Pay 2,000 points at an active dragon platform to ride to the Hatchery, where Pack-a-Punch is available. The stations are Dragon Command, Supply Depot and Tank Factory. Leave through the Hatchery’s lower sewer chute when finished. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Operations shield workbench
locations.description: Collect one shield piece from each group, then build at the Operations Bunker bench. Hold the shield in front of you during dragon fire; wearing it on your back does not protect your exposed front. Its fire blast is also needed for a trophy. Visage: Infirmary shelf near the middle-floor stairs, rubble by the broken Operations walkway, or upper floor beside Stamin-Up. Core: chair beside Juggernog in Department Store, the truck toward Operations Bunker, or a shelf inside Operations Bunker. Maw: Armory ground-floor rubble by Wunderfizz, the middle-floor wall beside the crashed-bus walkway, or upper-floor wall by the bridge. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
